free_tier.stated: 5 users, 10 concurrent jobs and 2,000 Linux vCPU-minutes a month, plus 250,000 test executions a month

per_object_cap.stated: 10 GiB per artifact uploaded from an agent, and 50 GiB of artifacts in one job's upload batch

retention.stated: builds are stored 30 days on the Free plan (90 on Pro, 365 on Enterprise) and artifacts 30 days; the vCPU-minute pool is monthly

egress.terms: artifact downloads: 250 GB a month on the Free plan, 2.5 TB a month on Pro and then USD 0.10 per GB; no charge for network traffic from a hosted agent is published on the pricing, limits or hosted-agent pages
egress.free_allowance: 250 GB a month of artifact downloads
egress.price_per_tb: USD 100 per TB of artifact downloads beyond the Pro allowance; the Free plan names no overage

interface_detail: an agent you run, with Buildkite as the control plane; the bk CLI and a REST API
tooling: Buildkite-hosted Linux agents on the Free plan, small shape only, run the jobs with no machine of the user's; the buildkite-agent binary can also run on a VM from another provider and take jobs from the same pipelines
chaining: the Free plan supplies both the scheduler and a hosted machine; once the monthly vCPU-minute pool is spent, the same pipelines can dispatch to a buildkite-agent on a free or rented VM from another provider, which counts against the 10 concurrent self-hosted jobs rather than the pool

limits.value: Up to 2,000 Linux vCPU-minutes a month of Buildkite-hosted agents on the Free plan (Pro includes 4,000); usage is the shape's vCPU count times job runtime
Linux hosted-agent concurrency of 20 vCPU on the Free plan, which is 10 small machines at 2 vCPU each; further jobs queue until capacity frees
Job timeout of 4 hours on the Free plan; unlimited on Pro and Enterprise
